name: Segura de León (Spain)
description: White field framed by two borders of equal width, the outer white and the inner red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Segura de León (a castle on a rock, a cross of Saint James and a lion).
history: No record was found of any flag historically adopted by the municipality, so under Royal Decree 63/2001 a newly created flag was proposed following the vexillological principles of the autonomous community: a rectangular flag of 2:3, white, framed by two borders of equal thickness, the outer white and the inner red.

features.role: inner red frame within a white outer border
